description: RAINOUT is established as a small collective of 4 members: Jori, angelfriend, V0CALYST, and suuni. Suuni officially named the collective 'RAINOUT collective.'
Suuni creates the first RAINOUT logo.
angelfriend releases the first trailer for her debut EP 'A witness, A watcher'
Suuni adopts the 'believe the kids' slogan for RAINOUT.
Suuni releases his debut experimental EP 'NORMALIZE HITTING HOES YOU DON'T LIKE'
Angelfriend releases her debut EP 'A witness, A watcher'
Lunamaryllis, Shinrei, and Seraphim all join RAINOUT as Jori looks for new members.
V0CALYST drops the first major RAINOUT single involving production from lunamaryllis and shinrei, 'believe the kids'
Shinrei designs the RAINOUT logo and typography that has consistently been used today.
